en.metadata.name: Token Budget
en.plugin.description: Set daily, weekly, monthly or cumulative UTC token and USD budgets per key, and view the metering ledger.
en.error.keys: Unable to load API Keys. Refresh and try again.
en.error.missingKey: The API Key in this link does not exist.
en.reason.notReady: The plugin is not ready. Editing is temporarily unavailable.
en.ui.title: API Key Budgets
en.ui.description: Set token or USD budgets per API Key, with daily, weekly, monthly or cumulative limits. Unconfigured keys have no budget limit.
en.ui.behavior: New requests are rejected once the budget is exhausted. Admitted requests continue, so final usage may exceed the limit.
en.ui.empty: No API Keys yet. Create one in Access Control, then configure its budget.
en.ui.editDescription: Changes apply after saving; canceling preserves the current budget.
en.ui.usdHelp: Uses estimated costs from Token Statistics. Requests are rejected when model prices are unavailable. If a sent request has an unknown cost, further monetary-budget requests for this key are paused.
en.ui.dailyDescription: A new daily budget starts at 00:00 UTC each day.
en.ui.weeklyDescription: A new weekly budget starts at 00:00 UTC each Monday.
en.ui.monthlyDescription: A new monthly budget starts at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month.
en.ui.cumulativeDescription: Deducted from historical total usage; does not reset automatically.
en.ui.exhaustedWarning: The limit does not exceed recorded usage. Saving will reject new budgeted requests.
en.ui.history: Changing the limit, unit or period does not clear recorded usage. New daily, weekly and monetary dimensions only count attributable records collected after the upgrade; earlier history is not backfilled.
en.ui.usageDescription: Budgets settle against the UTC period when the request was admitted.
en.ui.noBudget: This key currently has no budget limit.
en.ui.unknownWarning: Some request metering awaits recovery. This budget is currently paused for new requests.
en.ui.ledgerHelp: Budgets count only requests admitted while a budget is enabled; admitted requests may still await settlement. Token Statistics aggregates by completion time, includes requests without a budget, and retains the latest 31 days of details. Requests crossing periods may belong to different time ranges.
en.ui.legacyWarning: Older records lack exact dates or costs. Cumulative and monthly token usage is retained; new dimensions do not backfill this history.
en.ui.statisticsHelp: View detailed tokens and estimated costs in Token Statistics. It will automatically filter to the current API Key.
en.error.load: Unable to load budgets. Refresh and try again.
en.error.usd: Enter a USD amount greater than 0 with at most six decimal places.
en.error.tokens: Enter a positive integer token limit.
en.error.save: Saving was not confirmed. Refresh to check the actual budget before retrying.
en.reason.key: This key is {status}; its budget is read-only.
en.reason.disabled: The plugin is disabled; budgets are read-only.

zh-CN.metadata.name: Token 预算
zh-CN.plugin.description: 按 Key 设置 UTC 每日、每周、每月或累计 Token 与美元预算，并查看计量账本。
zh-CN.ui.searchPlaceholder: 搜索 Key 名称或前缀
zh-CN.error.keys: 无法读取 API Key，请刷新重试。
zh-CN.error.missingKey: 链接中的 API Key 不存在。
zh-CN.reason.notReady: 插件尚未就绪，暂不可修改。
zh-CN.ui.title: API Key 预算
zh-CN.ui.description: 为每个 API Key 设置 Token 或 USD 预算，按每日、每周、每月或累计限制。未配置的 Key 不受预算限制。
zh-CN.ui.behavior: 额度用尽后拒绝新请求；已接纳请求继续，最终用量可能超过额度。
zh-CN.ui.empty: 尚无 API Key。请先在“访问控制”中创建，再为它设置预算。
zh-CN.ui.editDescription: 保存后生效；取消不会改变当前预算。
zh-CN.ui.usdHelp: 使用 Token 统计的估算费用。无模型价格时拒绝发送；已发送请求费用未知时，暂停此 Key 的后续金额预算请求。
zh-CN.ui.weeklyDescription: 每周一 00:00（UTC）使用新一周额度。
zh-CN.ui.monthlyDescription: 每月 1 日 00:00（UTC）开始使用新月份额度。
zh-CN.ui.cumulativeDescription: 按历史累计用量扣除，不自动重置。
zh-CN.ui.tokenLimit: Token 额度（输入 + 输出）
zh-CN.ui.exhaustedWarning: 额度不高于已用量，保存后将拒绝新的预算请求。
zh-CN.ui.history: 修改额度、切换单位或周期不会清空已记录用量。新增日、周、金额维度仅计算升级后可归属的记录，不补算旧历史。
zh-CN.ui.usageDescription: 预算按请求接纳时的 UTC 周期结算。
zh-CN.ui.noBudget: 此 Key 当前不限制预算。
zh-CN.ui.unknownWarning: 部分请求计量待恢复，当前预算暂停接收新请求。
zh-CN.ui.ledgerHelp: 预算仅计入启用预算时接纳的请求；已接纳请求可能尚未结算。Token 统计按请求完成时间聚合，包含无预算期间的请求，并保留最近 31 天明细；跨周期请求可能归入不同时间段。
zh-CN.ui.legacyWarning: 旧记录缺少精确日期或费用，已保留累计、月度 Token 用量；新增维度不补算这些历史。
zh-CN.ui.statisticsHelp: 详细 Token 和估算费用请在 Token 统计中查看，打开后自动筛选当前 API Key。
zh-CN.error.load: 无法读取预算，请刷新重试。
zh-CN.error.usd: 请输入大于 0、最多六位小数的 USD 金额。
zh-CN.error.tokens: 请输入大于 0 的整数 Token 额度。
zh-CN.error.save: 保存未确认，请刷新核对实际预算后重试。
